about.title: Recovery built around your actual life
body: Shree Saai Ram Physiotherapy Clinic was started to give Thiruverkadu and the wider Chennai north-west belt a physiotherapy practice that treats recovery as a structured process, not a one-off session. Every patient gets an assessment, a written plan, and a realistic timeline — whether they're coming back from surgery, managing chronic pain, or trying to run again after a knee injury.

Our therapists work one-on-one with patients using a mix of manual therapy, targeted exercise, and modern equipment, with evening slots built around working schedules so treatment doesn't mean missing work.
highlights: One-on-one sessions, not shared floor time
Personalized recovery plans with clear milestones

services.name: Post-Surgical Rehabilitation
services.tagline: Structured recovery from the day you're cleared for therapy
services.overview: Whether you've had knee, hip, or shoulder surgery, our post-surgical rehab program restores strength and range of motion in a structured, phase-based way so you don't plateau or re-injure yourself.
symptoms: Stiffness and reduced range of motion after surgery
Difficulty bearing weight or returning to daily activity
procedure: Progressive loading with hands-on manual therapy
benefits: Faster, safer return to daily activity
Reduced risk of stiffness and re-injury
Plan coordinated with your surgeon's protocol
services.recovery: Typical rehab programs run 6–12 weeks depending on the surgery and starting condition, with milestones reviewed every two weeks.

faqs.question: How soon after surgery should I start physiotherapy?
faqs.answer: Most surgeons clear patients for physiotherapy within 1–2 weeks post-surgery — we coordinate with your surgeon's specific protocol before starting.

services.name: Sports Injury Recovery
services.tagline: Rehab built around getting back to your sport, not just off crutches
services.overview: From ligament sprains to muscle tears, our sports rehab program combines manual therapy and progressive strengthening with a real return-to-play timeline.
symptoms: Pain or instability during sport-specific movement
Reduced strength or confidence in the injured area
benefits: Rehab tailored to your specific sport
services.recovery: Recovery timelines vary from 3–16 weeks depending on injury severity and sport demands.

services.name: Back & Neck Pain Therapy
services.tagline: Relief that addresses the cause, not just the symptom
services.overview: Chronic back and neck pain is often driven by posture, muscle imbalance, or old injury patterns. We assess the root cause and build a plan combining manual therapy, posture correction, and strengthening.
symptoms: Persistent lower back or neck pain
Pain that worsens with sitting or desk work
benefits: Addresses root cause, not just symptoms
Long-term relief, not just short-term pain masking
services.recovery: Most patients see meaningful improvement within 4–6 weeks of consistent therapy.

services.name: Neurological Physiotherapy
services.tagline: Rebuilding movement and independence after neurological events
services.overview: For patients recovering from stroke, nerve injury, or other neurological conditions, our therapists focus on restoring movement, balance, and functional independence through targeted, patient-paced rehabilitation.
symptoms: Weakness or reduced coordination on one side of the body
services.recovery: Neurological rehab is typically a longer-term program, reviewed and adjusted every 4 weeks.

services.name: Geriatric Mobility Therapy
services.tagline: Staying steady, mobile, and independent with age
services.overview: Our geriatric mobility program focuses on balance, strength, and fall prevention, helping older adults stay independent and confident in daily movement.
symptoms: Reduced balance or fear of falling
services.recovery: Ongoing maintenance programs are common; most patients see improved balance within 6–8 weeks.

faqs.question: Do I need a doctor's referral to book an appointment?
faqs.answer: No referral is required — you can book an assessment directly, though we're happy to coordinate with your surgeon or physician if you have one.

faqs.question: How long does a typical session last?
faqs.answer: Initial assessments run about 45–60 minutes; follow-up sessions are typically 30–45 minutes depending on your treatment plan.

faqs.question: Do you offer home visits?
faqs.answer: Home visits can be arranged for patients with limited mobility — please call ahead to check availability.

faqs.question: What should I bring to my first visit?
faqs.answer: Bring any relevant medical reports, imaging, or surgeon notes, along with comfortable clothing that allows movement of the affected area.

faqs.question: What is your cancellation policy?
faqs.answer: Please give at least 24 hours notice to reschedule or cancel an appointment.

blogPosts.title: Why a Structured Recovery Plan Beats a Generic Timeline
blogPosts.excerpt: A calendar date isn't a recovery plan. Here's why milestone-based physiotherapy gets patients back to full activity faster and safer.
blogPosts.author: Arun Prakash
content: "Come back in six weeks" is not a recovery plan — it's a guess. Real recovery depends on how your body actually responds to treatment, not a number on a calendar.
At Shree Saai Ram Physiotherapy, every patient gets a plan built around measurable milestones: range of motion, strength symmetry, and functional movement, reviewed every two weeks.
This matters most for post-surgical and sports injury patients, where returning to activity too early — or too late — both carry real risk.
If your current therapy plan doesn't have clear, measurable checkpoints, it's worth asking what you're actually being measured against.
